people.name: Pamela
people.text: Pamela’s family is quite wealthy and lives in the city centre. She misses the countryside and loves reading and long country walks. She hates hot weather and holidays by the sea.
people.hint: 💡 Countryside, reading and walking; avoid a seaside holiday.

people.name: Rob
people.text: Rob is interested in music. He loves places where there is a good art scene. He likes meeting people, being in a town or city and prefers walking or cycling to using public transport.
people.hint: 💡 City, art, music, people, and places within walking distance.

people.name: Sue
people.text: Sue’s trying to get into art school. She wants a peaceful environment and maybe some company while she paints. She wants a chance to practise her French or Spanish.
people.hint: 💡 Creative, peaceful, sociable, with a chance to use Spanish.

people.name: Tim and Ben
people.text: Tim and Ben are really sporty so they are looking for an activity holiday doing water sports. They’re not really interested in city life but want to be near enough to be able to go out in the evenings.
people.hint: 💡 Water sports outside the city, but with easy access to town at night.

people.name: May
people.text: May enjoys going abroad for beaches, sunshine and a good place to eat as she loves foreign food. But May’s family hasn’t got a lot of money so travel and accommodation need to be cheap.
people.hint: 💡 Cheap foreign beach holiday with local food and easy travel.

options.title: The Mochito Surf Club
options.body: Situated five kilometres from a small holiday town, complete with cinemas and restaurants, the Mochito Surf Club offers great holidays for those who love to be on the waves all day. Accommodation is in shared tents with great bathroom and self-catering facilities. A mini bus runs to the town during the day and evening!

options.title: The Resort
options.body: The Resort is a great place for single young people to meet. It's not too expensive and has great facilities, such as tennis courts and two swimming pools. Good food is served in the restaurant and there is live music every night and dancing! Buses to the nearest town run every hour.

options.title: The Calypso Beach Hotel
options.body: The best beaches in this country are waiting for you at the Calypso Beach Hotel. The hotel is situated by the sea with wonderful views. Excellent rooms and the best Greek cooking you can imagine. Recommended if cost is not considered in your holiday plans, as luxury does not come cheap.

options.title: Le Casa
options.body: Le Casa is a bed and breakfast that feels like home. A family business, it's perfect for those who don't want to spend all their savings on accommodation. The town, which is full of beach restaurants serving delicious local dishes, is on the Spanish coast. There is easy access from the local airport by local buses.

options.title: The Lodge
options.body: The Lodge is the perfect get-away-from-it-all holiday; for those who want to escape the city. Situated by a lake, The Lodge offers luxury facilities with the peace and quiet of walking tracks through the forest, an indoor swimming pool and a library where you can relax with your favourite books. Not cheap but worth every penny!

options.title: The Meeting House
options.body: The Meeting House, in Barcelona, attracts mainly students and is perfect for those who want a cultural holiday; everything is within reach on foot. Centrally located in the fashionable cafe area, it is close to art galleries as well as cafe bars, offering live music to suit all tastes. Prices are reasonable for rooms with shared facilities.

options.title: The Retreat
options.body: The Retreat offers a quiet creative environment for artists and musicians. Join groups for all levels to learn techniques in sociable fun classes. Classes are in English but a working knowledge of Spanish is an advantage. So if you enjoy the countryside, far away from the stress of the city, this is for you.

options.title: The Sea House
options.body: The Sea House is ideal for those who love peace and quiet. Located in the English county of Cornwall, it has unforgettable views over the sea. It's a great place for artists who don't want their creativity interrupted by visitors. Available all seasons but summer is definitely the best! The earlier you book, the better the price!

explanation.name: Pamela
explanation.demand: Countryside, reading, long walks, peace and no seaside holiday.
explanation.key: E đúng vì The Lodge có forest walking tracks, library và không gian yên tĩnh. H cũng yên tĩnh nhưng ở cạnh biển, điều Pamela không thích.

explanation.name: Rob
explanation.demand: Music, art, meeting people, city life, walking/cycling.
explanation.key: F đúng vì ở Barcelona, gần art galleries, cafe bars và live music, đồng thời mọi thứ đều trong khoảng đi bộ.

explanation.name: Sue
explanation.demand: Peaceful creative place, some company, chance to practise Spanish.
explanation.key: G đúng vì đây là môi trường sáng tạo cho artists and musicians, có classes mang tính xã hội và Spanish is an advantage.

explanation.name: Tim and Ben
explanation.demand: Water sports, outside city, but nightlife accessible.
explanation.key: A đúng vì có water sports, nằm ngoài town nhưng có mini bus vào town cả ngày lẫn buổi tối.

explanation.name: May
explanation.demand: Beach, sunshine, foreign food, cheap accommodation and travel.
explanation.key: D đúng vì nằm trên Spanish coast, có beach restaurants, chỗ ở tiết kiệm và dễ đi từ sân bay bằng bus.
